architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: add trainable cells while keeping dx=2um, or redesign pitch and cell count together; current 100x100 at 2um is 200um
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: more spatial degrees of freedom and improved angular focusing resolution; aperture increase alone does not raise sampled-phase Nyquist angle
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: larger modulator, more driven cells, calibration burden and loss of compact footprint

architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: last-mask-to-fiber distance >= 0.00419175 m for the outermost center under the current per-axis steering criterion, versus current 0.0015 m
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: reduces required steering angles without changing fiber pitch
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: longer optical path, larger footprint, tighter vibration/alignment control and new propagation/convergence checks

architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: design/calibrate a relay mapping the 200um mask field to the 1.25mm reference array extent; first-order magnification is about 6.25x and must be derived for selected conjugate planes
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: decouples mask aperture from fiber-array span and controls field placement
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: extra optics, aberration/loss/alignment budget, relay calibration and a changed forward model

architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.alternative: reduce fiber pitch or use alternative fiber geometry
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: current per-axis criterion requires pitch <= 4.47307e-05 m at this distance; this conflicts with the 125um reference cladding diameter and needs a different geometry/mode bank
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: brings all centers into the current sampled steering envelope
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: fiber packaging, cross-talk, mode isolation and fabrication constraints; current cladding reference would overlap

architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: use at most a centered 4x4 subset at the present 125um pitch and 1.5mm distance for direct sampled-phase reachability; revise the channel interface
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: retains ports within the current steering envelope without implying unsupported outer-port coverage
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: lower channel capacity and a changed 100-port OLS contract

architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.required_change: add and calibrate a fan-out optic that splits the field toward the 10x10 fiber centers
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_advantage: creates multiple distributed spots without requiring one phase ramp to steer to every port
architecture_alternatives_not_implemente.predicted_cost: insertion loss, phase quantization, alignment, cross-talk and new physical validation
